G4863.def:
**συν-άγω **
[in LXX chiefly for אָסַף, also for קָבַץ, etc. (cf. Kennedy, _Sources_, 128) ;]
**to gather or bring together**: of things, [[Jhn.6.12-13;|Jhn.6:12-13]] before εἰς, [[Mat.3.12|Mat.3:12]], al.; ἐκεῖ, [[Luk.12.18|Luk.12:18]] ποῦ, [[Luk.12.17|Luk.12:17]] συναγαγὼν πάντα (sc. εἰς ἀργύριον; see Field, _Notes_, 68, MM, xxiv), **having sold off all**: [[Luk.15.13|Luk.15:13]] of persons, [[Jhn.11.52|Jhn.11:52]] esp. of assemblies, [[Mat.2.4|Mat.2:4]], [[Jhn.11.47|Jhn.11:47]], [[Act.14.27|Act.14:27]], al. Pass., **to be gathered or come together**: [[Mat.22.41|Mat.22:41]], [[Mrk.2.2|Mrk.2:2]], [[Luk.22.66|Luk.22:66]], al.; before ἐπί [[Mrk.5.21|Mrk.5:21]], [[Act.4.27|Act.4:27]]; πρός, [[Mat.13.2|Mat.13:2]], [[Mrk.4.1|Mrk.4:1]], al.; εἰς, [[Rev.19.17|Rev.19:17]] ἐν, [[Act.11.26|Act.11:26]] μετά, [[Mat.28.12|Mat.28:12]] οὗ, [[Mat.18.20|Mat.18:20]] ὅπου, [[Mat.26.57|Mat.26:57]] ἐκεῖ, [[Jhn.18.2|Jhn.18:2]], al.
In late writers (see Kennedy, _Sources_, 128; cf. [[Deu.22.2|Deu.22:2]], al.), **to receive hospitably, entertain**: [[Mat.25.35, 38; 25.43|Mat.25:35, 38 25:43]] (cf. ἐπι-συνάγω)
(AS)

G4851.def:
**συμ-φέρω **
[in LXX: [[Jer.33.14|Jer.33:14]] (טוֹב), [[Pro.19.10|Pro.19:10]] (נָאוֶה), [[Sir.30.19|Sir.30:19]], al. ;]
1. trans. to bring together: with accusative of thing(s), [[Act.19.19|Act.19:19]]
2. Intrans., and mostly impers., συμφέρει, **it is expedient, profitable or an advantage**: [[1Co.6.12; 10.23|1Co.6:12 10:23]], [[2Co.8.10|2Co.8:10]]; with inf. (M, _Pr._, 210), [[Mat.19.10|Mat.19:10]], [[Jhn.18.14|Jhn.18:14]]; with dative, before ἵνα (Bl., § 69, 5), [[Mat.5.29-30; 18.6|Mat.5:29-30 18:6]], [[Jhn.11.50; 16.7|Jhn.11:50 16:7]]. Ptcp., ςυμφέρων, **profitable**: [[1Co.12.7|1Co.12:7]] pl., [[Act.20.20|Act.20:20]] (οὐ σ. sc. ἐστιν; = οὐ συμφέρει; cf. Thuc., iii, 44, 2), [[2Co.12.1|2Co.12:1]] as subst., τὸ σ., profit, [[Heb.12.10|Heb.12:10]]†
(AS)

G4816.def:
**συλ-λέγω **
[in LXX chiefly for לָקַט ;]
**to bring together, collect, gather up**: with accusative of thing(s), [[Mat.13.28-30;|Mat.13:28-30]] pass., [[Mat.13.40|Mat.13:40]] with accusative, before ἀπό, [[Mat.7.16|Mat.7:16]] id. before ἐκ, [[Mat.13.41|Mat.13:41]], [[Luk.6.44|Luk.6:44]]; before εἰς, [[Mat.13.48|Mat.13:48]]†
(AS)

G4873.def:
**συν-ανά-κειμαι **
[in LXX: [[3Ma.5.39|3Ma.5:39]] * ;]
**to recline with or together at table**: [[Mat.14.9|Mat.14:9]], [[Mrk.6.22|Mrk.6:22]], [[Luk.7.49; 14.15|Luk.7:49 14:15]]; with dative of person(s), [[Mat.9.10|Mat.9:10]], [[Mrk.2.15|Mrk.2:15]], [[Luk.14.10|Luk.14:10]].†
(AS)

G4824.def:
**συμβούλιον**, -ου, τό
(σύμβουλος), [in LXX: [[4Ma.17.17|4Ma.17:17]] א * ;]
a word of the Græco-Roman period (of. Lat. consilium, and see Deiss., BS, 238) = cl. συμβουλία (Arist., Xen.),
1. **counsel**: σ. λαμβάνειν, [[Mat.12.14; 22.15; 27.7; 28.12|Mat.12:14 22:15 27:7 28:12]]; διδόναι, [[Mrk.3.6|Mrk.3:6]] (ποιεῖν, Rec.); ποιεῖν, [[Mrk.15.1|Mrk.15:1]] (ἑτοιμάζειν, WH, mg.).
2. By meton., **a council **(4Mac, l.with א; συνέδριον, AR): [[Act.25.12|Act.25:12]] (see MM, xxiv).†
(AS)

G4846.def:
**συν-πνίγω** (Rec. συμπ-),
**to choke**: of thronging by a crowd, [[Luk.8.42|Luk.8:42]] Fig., of seed, τ. λόγον, [[Mat.13.22|Mat.13:22]], [[Mrk.4.7, 19|Mrk.4:7, 19]], [[Luk.8.14|Luk.8:14]].†
(AS)

G4885.def:
**συν-αυξάνω **
[in LXX: [[2Ma.4.4|2Ma.4:4]], [[4Ma.13.27|4Ma.13:27]] * ;]
to cause to increase or grow together. Pass., **to grow together**: [[Mat.13.30|Mat.13:30]] (Xen., al.).†
(AS)

G4856.def:
**συμ-φωνέω**, -ῶ,
[in LXX: [[Gen.14.3|Gen.14:3]] (H2266) [[2Sa.12.8|2Ki.12:8]] (9) (H225 ni.), [[Isa.7.2|Isa.7:2]] (H5117), [[4Ma.14.6|4Ma.14:6]] * ;]
prop., to agree in sound, be in harmony (Plat., Arist.). Metaphorical,
(a) **to agree with, agree together**: [[Luk.5.36|Luk.5:36]] with dative of thing(s), [[Act.15.15|Act.15:15]] before περί, [[Mat.18.19|Mat.18:19]] pass., with dative of person(s), συνεφωνήθη ὑμῖν, [[Act.5.9|Act.5:9]]
(b) **to agree as to a price **(Polyb., Diod.): with dative of person(s), genitive pret., [[Mat.20.13|Mat.20:13]] before μετά . . . ἐκ, [[Mat.20.2|Mat.20:2]]†
(AS)

G4868.def:
**συν-αίρω **
[in LXX: [[Exo.23.5|Exo.23:5]] (עָזַב) * ;]
**to take up together**: σ. λόγον (of which there are several exx. in π.; see Deiss., _LAE_, 118 f.; MM, i, xxiv; M, _Pr._, 160), to settle accounts, [[Mat.18.23-24;|Mat.18:23-24]] before μετά, C. genitive of person(s), [[Mat.25.19|Mat.25:19]]†
(AS)

G4801.def:
**συν-ζεύγνυμι**
(Rec. συζ-), [in LXX: [[Ezk.1.11, 23|Eze.1:11, 23]] (חָבַר) * ;]
**to yoke to­gether**: metaphorically, of union in wedlock, [[Mat.19.6|Mat.19:6]], [[Mrk.10.9|Mrk.10:9]].†
(AS)

G4862.def:
**σύν** (old Att. ξύν),
_prep. with dative, _
expressing association, fellowship and inclusion. It gradually gave way to μετά, with genitive (cf. LS, see word; Bl., §41, 3), and is therefore comparatively infrequent in NT, being rare in Mat.4, Mrk.6, Jhn.3, and elsewhere (exx. [[Jas.1.11|Jas.1:11]], [[2Pe.1.18|2Pe.1:18]]) only in Lk (Gosp. and Ac) and Paul. **With, together with**: of companionship and association, [[Luk.2.13|Luk.2:13]], [[Jhn.21.3|Jhn.21:3]], [[Act.10.23|Act.10:23]], al.; εἶναι σύν τινι, [[Luk.7.12|Luk.7:12]], [[Act.4.13|Act.4:13]], [[Php.1.23|Php.1:23]], al.; of partisanship, [[Act.4.13|Act.4:13]] οἱ σύν τινι, of attendants, companions or colleagues, [[Mrk.2.26|Mrk.2:26]], [[Luk.5.9|Luk.5:9]], [[Act.5.17|Act.5:17]], al.; of assistance, ἡ χάρις τ. θεοῦ σὺν ἐμοί, [[1Co.15.10|1Co.15:10]] of two or more things together, almost = καί, [[Luk.23.11|Luk.23:11]], [[Act.3.4; 10.2; 14.5; 23.25|Act.3:4 10:2 14:5 23:25]], [[Eph.3.18|Eph.3:18]]; σὺν Χριστῷ ζῆν, [[2Co.13.4|2Co.13:4]] besides (FlJ, LXX), σὺν πᾶσι τούτοις, [[Luk.24.21|Luk.24:21]] In composition: **with** (συνχαίρω), **together** (συνωδίνω), **altogether** (συντελέω)
(AS)

G4823.def:
1. **to advise, counsel **, Lat. _consulere alicui_, with _dative_ pers. et _infinitive_, **to advise ** one to do a thing, (Herdotus Historicus), etc.
2. without the _infinitive_, ς. τινί τι (Herdotus Historicus); ς. τι **to recommend ** a measure, (Herdotus Historicus), attic:—;Pass., τὰ συμβουλευόμενα **the advice given **, (Xenophon Historicus)
3. _absolute_ **to advise, give advice **, (Sophocles Tragicus); ὁ συμβουλεύων or -εύσας, **an adviser **, Lat. _auctor sententiae_, (Aristotle Philosopher)
4. Mid. **to consult with ** a person, i. e. **ask ** his **advice **, Lat. _consulere aliquem_, with _dative_, (Herdotus Historicus), etc.: _absolute_ **to consult, deliberate **, (Xenophon Historicus) (ML)

G4815.def:
**συλ-λαμβάνω **
[in LXX for תָּפַשׂ, הָרָה, etc. ;]
1. with accusative, to bring together, collect.
2. **to seize, take**: with accusative of person(s), as a prisoner, [[Mat.26.55|Mat.26:55]], [[Mrk.14.48|Mrk.14:48]], [[Luk.22.54|Luk.22:54]], [[Jhn.18.12|Jhn.18:12]], [[Act.1.16; 12.3|Act.1:16 12:3]]; pass., [[Act.23.27|Act.23:27]] mid., in sense of act., [[Act.26.21|Act.26:21]] σ. ἄγραν ἰχθύων, [[Luk.5.9|Luk.5:9]]
3. C. dative of person(s), to take part with, assist, succour; mid., in same sense: [[Luk.5.7|Luk.5:7]], [[Php.4.3|Php.4:3]].
4. **Of a woman, to conceive**: absol., [[Luk.1.24|Luk.1:24]] before ἐν γαστρί, [[Luk.1.31|Luk.1:31]] with accusative, [[Luk.1.36|Luk.1:36]] ib. before ἐν τ. κοιλίᾳ, [[Luk.2.21|Luk.2:21]] metaphorically, of lust producing sin, [[Jas.1.15|Jas.1:15]]†
(AS)

G4802.def:
**συν-ζητέω**
(Rec. συζ-), -ῶ, [in LXX: [[Neh.2.4|Neh.2:4]] AB1 (בָּקַשׁ pi.) * ;]
1. to search or examine together (Plat.).
2. In NT (and π., see MM, xxiii; also in M_Gr._, see Kennedy, _Sources_, 155), **to discuss, dispute**: [[Mrk.1.27; 12.28|Mrk.1:27 12:28]], [[Luk.24.15|Luk.24:15]]; before quæst. indir., [[Mrk.9.10|Mrk.9:10]] with dative of person(s), [[Mrk.8.11|Mrk.8:11]] [[Act.6.9|Act.6:9]]; before πρός, with accusative of person(s), [[Mrk.9.14, 16|Mrk.9:14, 16]], [[Act.9.29|Act.9:29]]; id. before quæst. indir., [[Luk.22.23|Luk.22:23]]†
(AS)

G4818.def:
**συν-λυπέω**
(Rec. συλλ-), -ῶ, [in LXX: [[Psa.69.20|Psa.69:20]], [[Isa.51.19|Isa.51:19]] (נוּד) * ;]
to make to grieve with (Arist.). Pass., **to be moved to grief by sympathy**: before ἐπί, with dative, [[Mrk.3.5|Mrk.3:5]]†
(AS)

G4870.def:
**συν-ακολουθέω**, -ῶ
[in LXX: [[2Ma.2.4|2Ma.2:4]] [[2Mac.2.6|2Mac 2:6]] * ;]
**to follow along with, accompany**: with dative of person(s), [[Mrk.14.51|Mrk.14:51]], [[Luk.23.49|Luk.23:49]]; before μετά, with genitive of person(s), [[Mrk.5.37|Mrk.5:37]]†
(AS)

G4849.def:
1. **a drinking-party, symposium **, (Theognis Elegiacus), etc.
2. **the room in which such parties were given, drinking-room **, (Lucian) (ML)

G4848.def:
**συν-πορεύομαι**
(Rec. σνμπ-), [in LXX chiefly for הָלַךְ ;]
1. **to journey together **(Plat., al.): with dative of person(s), [[Luk.7.11; 14.25; 24.15|Luk.7:11 14:25 24:15]].
2. **to come together**: [[Mrk.10.1|Mrk.10:1]] (Plut., al.).†
(AS)

G4819.def:
**συμ-βαίνω **
[in LXX for עָשָׂה, קָרָא, קָרָה, etc. ;]
1. to stand with the feet together.
2. to come together, come to terms.
3. **Of events, to come to pass, happen**: with dative of person(s), [[Mrk.10.32|Mrk.10:32]], [[Act.3.10; 20.19|Act.3:10 20:19]], [[1Co.10.11|1Co.10:11]], [[1Pe.4.12|1Pe.4:12]], [[2Pe.2.22|2Pe.2:22]]; absol., τὰ σνμβεβηκότα, [[Luk.24.14|Luk.24:14]] (cf. [[1Ma.4.26|1Ma.4:26]]); with accusative and nf., [[Act.21.35|Act.21:35]]†
(AS)

G4880.def:
**συν-απο-θνήσκω **
[in LXX: [[Sir.19.10|Sir.19:10]] * ;]
**to die with or together**: [[Mrk.14.31|Mrk.14:31]], [[2Co.7.3|2Co.7:3]] (see Meyer, in l), [[2Ti.2.11|2Ti.2:11]]†
(AS)

G4872.def:
**συν-ανα-βαίνω **
[in LXX for עָלָה ;]
**to go up with**: with dative of person(s), before εἰς, with accusative loc., [[Mrk.15.41|Mrk.15:41]], [[Act.13.31|Act.13:31]].†
(AS)

G4820.def:
**συν-βάλλω**
(Rec. συμ-), [in LXX: [[2Ch.25.19|2Ch.25:19]] (גָּרָה hith.), [[Isa.46.6|Isa.46:6]] (זוּל), [[Jer.43.3|Jer.43:3]] (סוּת hi.), [[Wis.5.8|Wis.5:8]], al. ;]
**to throw together, hence, **
(a) of speech (before λόγους, Eur., al.), **to discuss, confer **(sc. λόγους): with dative of person(s), [[Luk.11.53|Luk.11:53]], WH, mg., [[Act.17.18|Act.17:18]] before πρὸς ἀλλήλους, [[Act.4.15|Act.4:15]]
(b) **to reflect, consider, ponder**: ἐν τ. καρδίᾳ, [[Luk.2.19|Luk.2:19]]
(with) **to meet with, fall in with**: [[Act.20.14|Act.20:14]] in hostile sense, εἰς πόλεμον, with dative (εἰς μάχην, Polyb.), [[Luk.14.31|Luk.14:31]]
(d) mid., **to contribute **(Polyb., al.; cf. MM, xxiv): [[Act.18.27|Act.18:27]]†
(AS)

G4826.def:
**Συμεών**, ὁ indecl., (Heb. שִׁמְעוֹן),
Simeon (so always AV; RV in [[Luk.2.25, 34|Luk.2:25, 34]] only), Symeon, a _Heb._ name for which the Gk. Σίμων, which see, was also used;
1. the son of Jacob ([[Gen.29.33|Gen.29:33]]): [[Rev.7.7|Rev.7:7]].
2. **An ancestor of our Lord**: [[Luk.3.30|Luk.3:30]]
3. **An aged worshipper in the Temple**: [[Luk.2.25, 34|Luk.2:25, 34]].
4. **One surnamed Niger**: [[Act.13.1|Act.13:1]]
5. **The apostle Peter**: [[Act.15.14|Act.15:14]], [[2Pe.1.1|2Pe.1:1]] (R, txt., WH, txt., Σίμων).†
(AS)

G4811.def:
**συκοφαντέω**, -ῶ
(σῦκον, φαίνω), [in LXX: [[Gen.43.18|Gen.43:18]] (גָּלַל hithpo.), [[Lev.19.11|Lev.19:11]] (שָׁקַר pi.), [[Job.35.9|Job.35:9]], [[Psa.119.122|Psa.119:122]], [[Pro.14.31; 2.16; 28.3|Pro.14:31 2:16 28:3]], [[Ecc.4.1|Ecc.4:1]] (עָשַׁק) ;]
to act the συκοφάντης (on conjectures as to the origin of the term, see LS, see word), **to accuse falsely **(Aristoph., Xen., al.): [[Luk.3.14|Luk.3:14]] (R, mg.) [[Luk.19.8|Luk.19:8]] (RV, exact wrongfully; but cf. Hatch, _Essays_, 89 ff., see also Field, _Notes_, 56 f.; MM, xxiv).†
(AS)

G4855.def:
**συν-φύω**
(Rec. συμ-), [in LXX: [[Wis.13.13|Wis.13:13]] * ;]
to cause to grow together. Pass., **to grow together or with **(Plat. al.): [[Luk.8.7|Luk.8:7]]†
(AS)

G4845.def:
**συν-πληρόω**
(Rec. συμπ-), -ῶ, [in LXX: [[Jer.25.12|Jer.25:12]] (נָפַל) * ;]
1. **to fill up completely **(Thuc., of manning ships): of a ship filling with water, and by meton., of those on board, [[Luk.8.23|Luk.8:23]]
2. **to complete, fulfil**: of time (Je, l.with, and see MM, xxiv), [[Luk.9.51|Luk.9:51]], [[Act.2.1|Act.2:1]] (on the "durative inf.," see M, _Pr._, 233).†
(AS)

G4884.def:
**συν-αρπάζω **
[in LXX: [[Pro.6.25|Pro.6:25]] (לָקַח), [[2Ma.3.27|2Ma.3:27]] [[2Mac.4.41|2Mac 4:41]], [[4Ma.5.4|4Ma.5:4]] * ;]
"perfective " of ἁοπάζω (see M, _Pr._, 113),
(a) to seize and carry away (so most commonly) : [[Act.27.15|Act.27:15]]
(b) **to seize and hold**: [[Luk.8.29|Luk.8:29]], [[Act.6.12; 19.29|Act.6:12 19:29]].†
(AS)

G4895.def:
**σύν-ειμι**
(εἰμί to be), [in LXX: [[Jer.3.20|Jer.3:20]] (רֵעַ), al. ;]
**to be with**: [[Luk.9.18|Luk.9:18]] (WH, mg., συνήντησαν), [[Act.22.11|Act.22:11]]†
(AS)

G4876.def:
**συν-αντάω**, -ῶ
[in LXX for פָּגַע, פָּגַשׁ, קָרָא, קָרָה, etc. ;]
**to meet with**: with dative of person(s), [[Luk.9.18, 37; 22.10|Luk.9:18, 37 22:10]], [[Act.10.25|Act.10:25]], [[Heb.7.1, 10|Heb.7:1, 10]]. Metaphorical, of events, **to happen, befall **(Ding. L., Plut., al.): [[Act.20.22|Act.20:22]]†
(AS)

G4878.def:
**συν-αντι-λαμβάνομαι **
[in LXX: [[Gen.30.8|Gen.30:8]] R (†), [[Exo.18.22|Exo.18:22]], [[Num.11.17|Num.11:17]] (נָשָׂא), [[Psa.89.21|Psa.89:21]] (כּוּן ni.) * ;]
**to take hold with at the side for assistance; hence, to take a share in, help in bearing, and generally, help **(with various constructions, see LXX, ll. with, Deiss., _LAE_, 83 f.): with dative, [[Luk.10.40|Luk.10:40]], [[Rom.8.26|Rom.8:26]].†
(AS)

G4858.def:
**συμφωνία**, -ας, ἡ
(σύμφωνος), [in LXX: Dan LXX TH [[Dan.3.5, 15|Dan.3:5, 15]], TH [[Dan.3.7, 10|Dan.3:7, 10]] (סוּמְפּוֹנְיָה) [[4Ma.14.3|4Ma.14:3]] A * ;]
1. **symphony, music**: [[Luk.15.25|Luk.15:25]]
2. a musical instrument (Polyb., al.; Da, ll. with; v MM, xxiv).†
(AS)

G4807.def:
**συκάμινος**, -ου, ἡ
[in LXX for שִׁקְמָה (pl.) ;]
**the mulberry tree **
(Lat. morus; cf. μόρον, [[1Ma.6.34|1Ma.6:34]] *),
**the sycamine**: [[Luk.17.6|Luk.17:6]] (In LXX, σ. appears to represent the συκόμορος (see: συκομορέα), but St. Luke distinguishes between the two; see _ICC_, in l; _DB_, iv, 634.) †
(AS)

G4809.def:
**συκο-μορέα** (Rec. -μωραία, L, -μωρέα), -ας, ἡ, more commonly (so Aq., Sm., [[Psa.78.47|Psa.78:47]], [[Isa.9.10|Isa.9:10]]) συκόμορος
(σῦκον + μόρον, the black mulberry),
**a fig-mulberry, a sycamore**: [[Luk.19.4|Luk.19:4]] (cf. συκάμινος).†
(AS)

G4817.def:
**συλ-λογίζομαι **
[in LXX chiefly for חָשַׁב pi. ;]
1. to compute.
2. **to reason**: [[Luk.20.5|Luk.20:5]]†
(AS)

G4836.def:
**συν-παρα-γίνομαι**
(Rec. συμπ-), [in LXX: [[Psa.83.8|Psa.83:8]] (לָוָה ni.) * ;]
1. **to come up or be present together**: before ἐπί, [[Luk.23.48|Luk.23:48]]
2. to come up to assist (Thuc., al.; [[2Ti.4.16|2Ti.4:16]], Rec.).†
(AS)

G4897.def:
**συν-εισ-έρχομαι **
[in LXX: [[Job.22.4|Job.22:4]] (עִם בּוֹא), etc. ;]
**to enter together**: with dative of person(s), before εἰς, with accusative loc., [[Jhn.6.22; 18.15|Jhn.6:22 18:15]].†
(AS)

G4827.def:
**συν-μαθητής** (Rec. συμμ-), -οῦ, ὁ
**a fellow-disciple**: [[Jhn.11.16|Jhn.11:16]] (on the use of συν- in such compounds as this, see Rutherford, _NPhr._, 255 f.).†
(AS)

G4871.def:
**συν-αλίζω **
[in Al.: [[Psa.141.4|Psa.141:4]] * ;]
**to assemble with**: [[Act.1.4|Act.1:4]] (EV, mg., eating with, but on this rendering and on the force of the Pres. ptcp. here, see Field, _Notes_, 110).†
(AS)

G4894.def:
**συν-εῖδον ** irreg. aorist of συνοράω (see: εἶδον),
[in LXX: [[1Ma.4.21|1Ma.4:21]] א, [[2Ma.2.24|2Ma.2:24]] [[2Mac.4.4|2Mac 4:4]] [[2Mac.4.41|2Mac 4:41]] R [[2Ma.5.17|2Ma.5:17]] [[2Mac.7.4|2Mac 7:4]] [[2Mac.7.20|2Mac 7:20]] [[2Mac.8.8|2Mac 8:8]], [[3Ma.2.8|3Ma.2:8]] A * ;]
1. to see together or at the same time (Arist., Xen.).
2. to see in one view, hence, of mental vision, to comprehend, understand (LXX, Polyb., Plut., al.) : [[Act.12.12; 14.6|Act.12:12 14:6]] (on the related σύνοιδα, see see word).†
(AS)

G4886.def:
**σύν-δεσμος**, -ου, ὁ
(συνδέω), [in LXX for קֶשֶׁר, קְטַר, etc. ;]
**that which binds together, a bond**: of the ligaments of the body, [[Col.2.19|Col.2:19]] Metaphorical, σ. ἀδικίας, [[Act.8.23|Act.8:23]] τ. τελειότητος, [[Col.3.14|Col.3:14]] τ. εἰρήνης, [[Eph.4.3|Eph.4:3]] (see Lft., Col., ll. with).†
(AS)

G4822.def:
**συν-βιβάζω**
(Rec. συμ-), [in LXX: [[Exo.4.12, 15|Exo.4:12, 15]], [[Lev.10.11|Lev.10:11]], [[Jdg.13.8|Jdg.13:8]], [[Psa.32.8|Psa.32:8]] (יָרָה hi.); [[Exo.18.16|Exo.18:16]], [[Deu.4.9|Deu.4:9]], [[Isa.40.13|Isa.40:13]] (יָדַע hi.), [[Isa.40.14|Isa.40:14]] (בִּין hi.), Da TH [[Dan.9.22|Dan.9:22]] (שָׂכַל hi.) * ;]
1. **to join or knit together, unite**: [[Eph.4.16|Eph.4:16]], [[Col.2.2|Col.2:2]] (but see infr.), [[Col.2.19|Col.2:19]]
2. **to compare, consider, conclude **(Plat.): [[Act.16.10|Act.16:10]]
3. **to deduce, prove, demonstrate **(Arist.): [[Act.9.22|Act.9:22]]
4. As in LXX ("translation Greek," = ἐμβιβάζω, metaphorically), **to teach, instruct**: [[1Co.2.16|1Co.2:16]] [[Act.19.33|Act.19:33]], R, mg. (also in Vg., [[Col.2.2|Col.2:2]], instructi, but see supr.).†
(AS)

G4844.def:
**συμπόσιον**, -ου, τό
(συμπίνω), [in LXX: [[Est.7.7|Est.7:7]] (מִשְׁתֶּה יַיִן) [[Est.4.17|Est.4:17]], [[1Ma.16.16|1Ma.16:16]], [[2Ma.2.27|2Ma.2:27]], [[3Ma.4.16|3Ma.4:16]] [[3Mac.5.36|3Mac 5:36]] [[3Mac.6.33|3Mac 6:33]]; σ. οἴνου, [[Sir.34.31|Sir 34:31]] (31:31) [[Sir.35.5|Sir.35:5]] (32:5), [[Sir.49.1|Sir.49:1]] * ;]
1. **a drinking party **
2. By meton., of the party itself, the guests (Plut); pl., σ. σ. (colloq.; see M, _Pr._, 97), **in parties or companies**: [[Mrk.6.39|Mrk.6:39]]†
(AS)

G4867.def:
**συν-αθροίζω **
[in LXX chiefly for קָבַץ ;]
**to gather together, assemble**: with accusative of person(s), [[Act.19.25|Act.19:25]] pass., [[Act.12.12|Act.12:12]]†
ἀθροίζω
(ἀθρόος, assembled in crowds, MM, _VGT_, see word; θρόος, a noise, tumult), [in LXX chiefly for קָבַץ ;]
**to Gather, assemble**: [[Luk.24.33|Luk.24:33]]†
(AS)

G4838.def:
**συν-παρα-λαμβάνω**
(Rec. συμπ-), [in LXX: [[Gen.19.17|Gen.19:17]] (סָפָה ni.), [[Job.1.4|Job.1:4]] (שָׁלַח ni), [[3Ma.1.1|3Ma.1:1]] * ;]
**to take along with**: as a companion, with accusative, [[Act.12.25; 15.37-38|Act.12:25 15:37-38]] (on the tenses, see M, _Pr._, 130), [[Gal.2.1|Gal.2:1]]†
(AS)

G4860.def:
**συμ-ψηφίζω **
[in LXX: [[Jer.29.20|Jer.29:20]] ([[Jer.49.20|Jer.49:20]]) A * ;]
**to reckon together, count up**: [[Act.19.19|Act.19:19]]†
(AS)

G4843.def:
**συν-περι-λαμβάνω** (Rec. συμπ-),
1. to enclose ([[Ezk.5.3|Eze.5:3]] (צוּר) *).
2. **to embrace**: with accusative of person(s), [[Act.20.10|Act.20:10]]†
(AS)

G4890.def:
**συνδρομή**, -ῆς, ἡ
(συντρέχω), [in LXX: [[Jdt.10.18|Jdth.10:18]], [[3Ma.3.8|3Ma.3:8]] * ;]
concourse, esp. of a riotous gathering: [[Act.21.30|Act.21:30]] (Arist., Polyb., al.).†
(AS)

G4840.def:
**συν-πάρειμι**
(Rec. σνμπ-), [in LXX: [[Tob.12.12|Tob.12:12]] ΑΒ, [[Pro.8.27|Pro.8:27]] (?), [[Wis.9.10|Wis.9:10]] * ;]
**to be present together or with**: with dative of person(s), [[Act.25.24|Act.25:24]]†
(AS)

G4837.def:
**συν-παρα-καλέω** (Rec. συμπ-), -ῶ,
to call upon or exhort together (Plat.). Pass., **to be strengthened or comforted with and among**: [[Rom.1.12|Rom.1:12]]†
(AS)

G4828.def:
**συν-μαρτυρέω** (Rec. συμμ-), -ῶ,
**to bear witness with**: [[Rom.2.15|Rom.2:15]] with dative, [[Rom.8.16|Rom.8:16]] before ὅτι, [[Rom.9.1|Rom.9:1]]†
(AS)

G4854.def:
**σύμ-φυτος**, -ον
(συμφύω, to make to grow together) [in LXX: [[Zec.11.2|Zec.11:2]] (בָּצַר), [[Est.7.7|Est.7:7]] [[Est.7.8|Est.7:8]] א2, [[Amo.9.13|Amo.9:13]], [[3Ma.3.22|3Ma.3:22]] * ;]
1. congenital, innate (Plat., al.; 3Mac, l.with).
2. **grown along with, united with**: τ. ὁμοιώματι τ. θανάτου αὐτσῦ (see Field, _Notes_, 155 f.), [[Rom.6.5|Rom.6:5]]†
(AS)

G4800.def:
**συν-ζάω** (Rec. συζ-),
**to live with**: opposite to συναποθανεῖν, [[2Co.7.3|2Co.7:3]] of life in union with Christ, here and hereafter, [[Rom.6.8|Rom.6:8]], [[2Ti.2.11|2Ti.2:11]].†
(AS)

G4852.def:
**σύν φημι** (Rec. συμ-),
**to consent, confess**: with dative, before ὅτι, [[Rom.7.16|Rom.7:16]]†
(AS)

G4841.def:
**συν-πάσχω**
(Rec. συμπ-), [in Al.: [[1Sa.22.8|1Ki.22:8]] * ;]
1. **to suffer together or with**: [[Rom.8.17|Rom.8:17]], [[1Co.12.28|1Co.12:28]].
2. to sympathize with (Plat., Arist.).†
(AS)

G4888.def:
**συν-δοξάζω **
1. to join in approving (Arist.).
2. **In NT only, to glorify together**: pass., [[Rom.8.17|Rom.8:17]]†
(AS)

G4832.def:
**σύμ-μορφος**, -ον
(σύν, μορφή),
1. absol., similar (Luc.).
2. **con­formed to**: with dative, [[Php.3.21|Php.3:21]] with genitive, [[Rom.8.29|Rom.8:29]] (see B1., § 36, 11; 37, 6).†
(AS)

G4825.def:
**σύμβουλος**, -ου, ὁ
(σύν, βουλή), [in LXX for יָעַץ and cogn. forms ;]
**a counsellor, adviser**: [[Rom.11.34|Rom.11:34]] (LXX).†
(AS)

G4879.def:
**συν-απ-άγω **
[in LXX: [[Exo.14.6|Exo.14:6]] (לָקַח) * ;]
to lead away with or together (Ex, l.with). Pass., metaphorically (as συμπεριφέρομαι, see LS, see word), **to be carried away with**: with dative, [[Gal.2.13|Gal.2:13]], [[2Pe.3.17|2Pe.3:17]]; of accommodating one­self to (EV, condescend to) things or persons (on the meaning, see _ICC_, in I.; Field, _Notes_, 163), [[Rom.12.16|Rom.12:16]]†
(AS)

G4865.def:
**συν-αγωνίζομαι **
**to strive together with, to help **(prop., of sharing in a contest): with dative of person(s) and of thing(s), [[Rom.15.30|Rom.15:30]]†
(AS)

G4875.def:
**συν-ανα-παύομαι **
[in LXX: [[Isa.11.6|Isa.11:6]] (רָבַץ) * ;]
with dative of person(s), to lie down to rest with, sleep with. Metaphorical, **to be refreshed in spirit with**: [[Rom.15.32|Rom.15:32]] (L, om.).†
(AS)

G4869.def:
**συν-αιχμάλωτος**, -ου, ὁ
**a fellow prisoner **(prop., of a captive in war, see Lft., Col., 234): [[Rom.16.7|Rom.16:7]], [[Col.4.10|Col.4:10]], Phm 23.†
(AS)

G4821.def:
**συμ-βουλεύω **
[in LXX chiefly for יָעַץ ;]
1. **to advise, counsel**: with dative of person(s), [[Jhn.18.14|Jhn.18:14]] id. before inf., [[Rev.3.18|Rev.3:18]]
2. Mid., **to take counsel, consult**: before ἵνα, [[Mat.26.4|Mat.26:4]] ("reciprocal middle," see M, _Pr._, 157); with inf., [[Act.9.23|Act.9:23]]†
(AS)

G4874.def:
**συν-ανα-μίγνυμι**
(accusative to Bl., 8, -μείγνυμι), [in LXX: [[Hos.7.8|Hos.7:8]] A ( hithpo.), [[Ezk.20.18|Eze.20:18]] A * ;]
**to mix up together**; pass., reflex, and metaphorically, **to associate with **(Plut., Ath., al.): [[1Co.5.9; 5.11|1Co.5:9 5:11]], [[2Th.3.14|2Th.3:14]] (see M, _Th._, 117).†
(AS)

G4859.def:
**σύμφωνος**, -ον
(ούν, φωνή), [in LXX: [[Ecc.7.14|Ecc.7:14]] (עֻמָּה), [[4Ma.7.7|4Ma.7:7]] [[4Mac.14.7|4Mac 14:7]] * ;]
agreeing in sound. Metaphorical, **harmonious, agreeing**: ἐκ συμφώνου (for exx. from π., see Deiss., BS, 255), by agreement, [[1Co.7.5|1Co.7:5]]†
(AS)

G4829.def:
**συν-μερίζω**
(Rec. συμμ-), [in LXX: [[Pro.29.24|Pro.29:24]] א2 (חָלַק) * ;]
to distri­bute in shares. Mid., **to have a share in**: [[1Co.9.13|1Co.9:13]] (Diod., al.).†
(AS)

G4857.def:
**συμ-φώνησις**, -εως, ἡ
(συμφωνέω),
**concord, agreement**: before πρός, with accusative of person(s), [[2Co.6.15|2Co.6:15]]†
(AS)

G4842.def:
**συν-πέμπω (Rec. συμπ-) **
**to send together with**: with accusative and dative, [[2Co.8.22|2Co.8:22]] id. before μετά, with genitive, [[2Co.8.18|2Co.8:18]]†
(AS)

G4813.def:
**συλάω**, -ῶ
[in LXX: Ep. [[Jer.1.18|Jer.1:18]] * ;]
with accusative of person(s), **to strip, plunder, spoil**: [[2Co.11.8|2Co.11:8]]†
(AS)

G4882.def:
**συν-απο-στέλλω **
[in LXX: [[Exo.33.2, 12|Exo.33:2, 12]] (שָׁלַח), I [[Est.5.2|Est.5:2]] * ;]
**to send along with**: with accusative, [[2Co.12.18|2Co.12:18]] (cf. MM, xxiv).†
(AS)

G4806.def:
**συν-ζωο-ποιέω** (Rec. συζ-), ῶ-,
**to make alive or quicken together with**; metaphorically, of the spiritual life: τ. Χριστῷ, [[Eph.2.5|Eph.2:5]] σὺν τ. Χ., [[Col.2.13|Col.2:13]]†
(AS)

G4891.def:
**συν-εγείρω **
[in LXX: [[Exo.23.5|Exo.23:5]] B2 (עָזַב), [[Isa.14.9|Isa.14:9]] (עוּר pil.), [[4Ma.2.14|4Ma.2:14]] * ;]
**to raise together**: metaphorically, of the Christian's mystical resur­rection with Christ, [[Eph.2.6|Eph.2:6]] pass., [[Col.2.12; 3.1|Col.2:12 3:1]].†
(AS)

G4847.def:
**συν-πολίτης** (Rec. σνμπ-), -ου, ὁ
**a fellow-citizen**: pl., σ. τ. ἁγίων, opposite to ξένοι κ. πάροικοι, [[Eph.2.19|Eph.2:19]] (Eur.; C.I., 6446; condemned by Atticists; see Rutherford, _NPhr._, 255 f.).†
(AS)

G4883.def:
**συν-αρμολογέω**, -ῶ
(ἁρμός, λέγω), = cl. συναρμόζω,
to fit or frame together: of the parts of a building, [[Eph.2.21|Eph.2:21]] of the members of the body, [[Eph.4.16|Eph.4:16]] (Eccl.).†
(AS)

G4830.def:
**συν-μέτοχος** (Rec. συμμ-), -ον,
**partaking together with**; as subst., ὁ σ., **a joint partaker **(with dative of person(s) and genitive of thing(s), FlJ, BJ, i, 24, 6): with genitive of thing(s), [[Eph.3.6|Eph.3:6]] with genitive of person(s), [[Eph.5.7|Eph.5:7]] (Arist.).†
(AS)

G4866.def:
**συν-αθλέω**, -ῶ
**= συναγωνίζομαι**: with dative commod., [[Php.1.27|Php.1:27]] with dative of person(s), before ἐν, [[Php.4.3|Php.4:3]]†
(AS)

G4833.def: Pass. **to be conformed to **, τινι (New Testament) (ML)

G4831.def:
**συν-μιμητής (Rec. συμμ-), -οῦ, ὁ **
**a fellow-imitator**: with genitive obj., [[Php.3.17|Php.3:17]] (see _ICC_, in l). Not elsewhere.†
(AS)

G4805.def:
**σύν-ζυγος** (Rec. ουζ-), or as WH, mg., Σύνζυγος, -ον
(συνζεύγνυμι), [in Aq., [[Ezk.23.21|Eze.23:21]] * ;]
a yoke fellow. Prob., as proper name, Σ. γνήσιε, genuinely Synzygus, S. properly so-called, [[Php.4.3|Php.4:3]] (see _ICC_, Lft., in l; MM, xxiii).†
(AS)

G4812.def:
**συλαγωγέω**, -ῶ
(σύλη, booty + ἄγω),
**to carry off as spoil, lead captive **(θυγατέρα, Heliod., Aeth., 10, 35): metaphorically, [[Col.2.8|Col.2:8]]†
(AS)

G4853.def:
**συμ-φυλέτης**, -ου, ὁ
(σύν, φυλή; cf. σύμφυλος, Aq.: [[Zec.13.7|Zec.13:7]] and see Rutherford, _NPhr._, 255 f.)
**a fellow-tribesman, fellow-countryman**: [[1Th.2.14|1Th.2:14]] (see M, _Th._, in l, and _Intr._ liii). Not found elsewhere.†
(AS)

G4834.def:
**συν-παθέω**
(Rec. συμπ-), -ῶ, [in LXX: [[4Ma.5.25|4Ma.5:25]] AR [[4Ma.13.23|4Ma.13:23]] * ;]
**to have a fellow feeling for or with, sympathize with or in**: with dative of thing(s), [[Heb.4.15|Heb.4:15]] dative of person(s), [[Heb.10.34|Heb.10:34]] (Arist., Plut., al.).†
(AS)

G4881.def:
**συν-απ-όλλυμι **
[in LXX chiefly for סָפָה ;]
to destroy with or together. Pass., **to perish together **(with): with dative of person(s), [[Heb.11.31|Heb.11:31]]†
(AS)

G4887.def:
**συν-δέω **
[in LXX for שָׁבַץ, etc. ;]
(a) **to bind together**;
(b) **to bind together with**: pass., [[Heb.13.3|Heb.13:3]]†
(AS)

G4835.def:
**συμπαθής**, -ές
(σύν, πάσχω) [in LXX: [[Job.29.25|Job.29:25]] A (אָבֵל), [[4Ma.5.25|4Ma.5:25]] א, [[4Ma.13.23|4Ma.13:23]] [[4Mac.15.4|4Mac 15:4]] * ;]
1. **affected by like feelings, sympathetic**: [[1Pe.3.8|1Pe.3:8]]
2. exciting sympathy (Jb, l.with; Dion. H.).†
(AS)

G4899.def:
**συν-εκ-λεκτός**, -ή, -όν
**chosen together with, co-elect**: ἡ ἐν Βαβυλῶνι συνεκλεκτή (on the meaning, see _ICC_, in l), [[1Pe.5.13|1Pe.5:13]]†
(AS)
